sum: Concord Biotech Limited intimated the NSE of an acquisition transaction on 20 June 2026, though the full disclosure document, target identity, consideration structure and deal value remain unconfirmed in public sources.

detail: Concord Biotech Limited, a listed pharmaceutical/biotech entity, filed an intimation of acquisition with the National Stock Exchange on 20 June 2026 (ref: NSE corporate action, timestamp 18:37:31). The NSE filing cover page is the only publicly accessible source confirming the acquisition event. The target entity, acquisition value, payment structure, conditions precedent, and timeline for completion are not disclosed in currently available public documents. Absence of a detailed company press release or full NSE schedule limits corroboration.
